heroText: Every ship, laser and module is earned by playing. Nothing that gives a combat advantage can be bought.
passText: Back the project: your subscription keeps development active and pays for the servers. In return, a few cosmetic and quality-of-life extras.
lt.avatar: Profile picture from an image link
col.name: Choose your name font, colour and animations, seen by everyone in game, chat and profile
col.hud: Pick the colour of the HUD
col.laser: Reshape each laser (the beam colour stays the game's)
linkHint: Become a patron on Patreon, then link your account here. Your level is read from your pledge and updates by itself.
linkFailed: Could not start the Patreon link. Sign in with an account (not a guest) and try again.
errNot: Your Patreon account is linked, but it has no active pledge for this game yet.
errFailed: The Patreon link failed. Please try again.
mottoHint: Up to 40 characters, shown on your profile.
avatarHelp: How to get an image link
avatarStep1: Upload your picture to an image host (for example Imgur or Discord).
avatarStep2: Open the image on its own and copy its address (right click > Copy image address).
avatarStep3: The link must start with https:// and end with a PNG, JPG or WebP file (GIF needs Colonel).
avatarStep4: Paste it above and press Save. The game fetches the image itself, so nobody sees your viewers' addresses.
avatarLimits: Up to 2 MB (4 MB for GIF). Pages that are not a direct image will not work.
lasersHint: One shape for each laser slot, in the order your lasers sit on the ship. Beam colours are not affected.
reportEmpty: No data yet. Your farm is recorded from now on.
flagHint: Report this profile's motto or picture to the team
modNote: A moderator removed your motto or picture. It cannot be set again.
